correction: Added one TikZ figure with two exact n=3 divisor orders, six vertices and six edges per panel, and captions defining a,b, upward covers, the atom join Delta, the shared six-element set and the n=2 degeneration. Original source retained as an exact byte prefix.

diagram_math_checks.result: Fixed n=3, a=sigma_1 and b=sigma_2. The triangular definition gives Delta=a(ba)=aba; the sole Artin relation in this alphabet gives aba=bab. Both a and b are exactly the two atoms. Every displayed vertex is a left and right divisor: the prefixes and suffixes of these two words are precisely 1,a,b,ab,ba,Delta.
diagram_math_checks.basis: def-positive-braid-monoid defining relations; def-garside-half-twist-and-simple-positive-braid triangular formula; assigned F1 and Statement (c).

diagram_math_checks.result: Bottom-to-top chains are 1<a<ab<Delta and 1<b<ba<Delta in the left order. Products are a=1*a, b=1*b, ab=a*b, ba=b*a, Delta=(ab)*a=(ba)*b. Smaller factors occur on the left, and every edge increases homogeneous length by one, hence is a cover.
diagram_math_checks.basis: def-left-and-right-divisibility-for-positive-braids definition a<=_L b iff b=ac; assigned F1 and proof 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.result: Bottom-to-top chains are 1<a<ba<Delta and 1<b<ab<Delta in the right order. Products are a=a*1, b=b*1, ba=b*a, ab=a*b, Delta=b*(ab)=a*(ba). Smaller factors occur on the right. The middle labels swap between panels; no equality of orders is asserted.
diagram_math_checks.basis: def-left-and-right-divisibility-for-positive-braids definition a<=_R b iff b=ca; assigned proof 2.1 and F4.

diagram_math_checks.result: The six vertices have six distinct permutations (identity, the two adjacent transpositions, their two ordered products and the longest permutation). Assigned (c) and the simple-braid supplier give 3!=6 divisors, so these are the complete n=3 intervals. No length-two relation exists on a,b, so a does not left-divide ba, b does not left-divide ab, and the opposite cross-edges are absent on the right. Length excludes other same-level relations; longer comparisons follow by transitivity. Both atoms therefore join at Delta in each full interval, and assigned (a),(b) prove this join in the entire monoid.

Executed Python enumeration of all binary words of lengths 0 through 3 and their equivalence closures under aba<->bab. Delta class was exactly ['aba','bab']; prefix and suffix classes both exactly ['',a,b,ab,ba,aba]. The computed cover lists were L: (1,a),(1,b),(a,ab),(ab,aba),(b,ba),(ba,aba); R: (1,a),(1,b),(a,ba),(ab,aba),(b,ab),(ba,aba), exactly matching the diagram.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Actual bounded word computation; homogeneity ensures no longer word can be equivalent to a word of length at most three.
